correctness.rationale: All-label extension proof is complete for arbitrary finite maximum-degree-two graphs. Four-state transfer matrices give the rational generating series. Standalone brute-force verification passed for 304 graph instances, 8,824 graph supports and 8,188 path supports. Finite checks are corroborative, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact-one-induced-edge microcanonical class is a natural vertex-subset concept on graphs. The theorem classifies every shattered support across all maximum-degree-two graphs, identifies a sharp degree-three obstruction, and supplies a complete path shattering series with a stable binomial regime and an exact VC dimension. Such a structural condition is useful beyond one finite sample or a routine numerical invariant, especially for comparing degree bounds and nonzero local-defect quotas.
